About

Designing for clarity, not decoration

I'm a final-year B.E. Computer Science and Engineering student at Bethlehem Institute of Engineering, Karungal, interested in UI/UX design.

I design in Figma, focusing on clear user flows and reducing confusion in everyday tasks — like knowing if a money transfer actually went through, or finding food quickly without a cluttered screen.

I've completed two full UI/UX projects end-to-end: a Food Delivery App and SecureBank, a mobile banking app. Both took me from wireframes through a working prototype.

I'm looking for an entry-level UI/UX role where I can keep learning by working on real products with a team.

Case Study 01

Food Delivery App

Overview — A mobile app for browsing and ordering food, designed solo in Figma from wireframes to a clickable prototype.

Objective

Make it fast and simple for a user to find food and complete an order without confusion.

My Role & Tool

UI/UX Designer — wireframes, UI design, and prototyping, done independently in Figma.

User Flow

Welcome/Login → Create Account → Home → Food Details → Cart → Checkout → Order Confirmation

Design Decision

Kept the ordering flow short — from selecting food to confirming an order in as few steps as possible.

What I Learned

How to keep a multi-step flow (browse → cart → checkout) simple without losing the user along the way.

Case Study 02

SecureBank

Overview — A mobile banking app designed solo in Figma, focused on trust and clarity during money transfers.

Objective

Design a transfer flow where users always feel informed and in control — specifically, reduce confusion about whether a transfer worked, and avoid surprises about money leaving their account.

My Role & Tool

UI/UX Designer — end-to-end, from problem framing to prototype, in Figma.

User Flow

Splash → Login → OTP Verification → Dashboard → Send Money → Review Transfer → Success / Failed → Transaction History → Settings

UX Decisions

Designed separate, clear Success and Failed states so users are never left unsure whether their money actually moved. Added a confirmation/review step before money leaves the account, so users explicitly approve the transfer.

Accessibility

A Simplified Mode toggle and Tamil-language support, for users less comfortable with English or complex interfaces.

What I Learned

How small states — like a clear "Failed" screen instead of silence — change how much a user trusts an app.
